content:
There is something about Rarotonga that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those chasing culinary experiences in Rarotonga, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Must-Try Dishes

- Signature street food that locals eat daily
- Traditional dishes passed down through generations
- Regional specialties unique to Rarotonga
- Modern interpretations of classic Rarotonga cuisine

![Food in Rarotonga](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1668889495576-bbd35db21a66?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Best Food Experiences

Farm-to-table restaurants in Rarotonga showcase the freshest local ingredients in creative preparations.

## Dining Tips

- Ask locals for recommendations — they know the best hidden spots
- Try the daily specials at local restaurants for authentic flavors
- Visit markets early in the morning for the freshest produce
- Do not be afraid to try unfamiliar dishes — surprises are often the best
